subject: EdgeCol private deployment: gateway handoff and credentials sweep
messages:
From: Ryan Matthews <ryan.matthews@edgecol.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@edgecol.com
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Gateway handoff + credentials we promised

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for yesterday's kickoff. The infra team asked me to confirm the exact list of items you need before we hand over the edge gateway and egress credentials. At a minimum they called out:
- Public IPs/nat allocation and egress IP ranges
- VPN or Direct Connect details (certs, PSKs)
- Service account email + key distribution method
- Firewall allowlist / port matrix for 10.0.0.0/16

I'm attaching our current network diagram so you can point to the attachment names we should export.

Can you send a single checklist we can use to tick off before turning over access? We aim to complete this by EOD today.

Cheers,
Ryan

--
Ryan Matthews
Head of Infrastructure, EdgeCol Logistics
ryan.matthews@edgecol.com
Attachment: edgecol_infra_network_diagram_v1.pdf

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: Ryan Matthews <ryan.matthews@edgecol.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Gateway handoff + credentials we promised

Hi Ryan — thanks for sending the diagram.

High-level plan (quick):
1) We validate the diagram and confirm the egress IP ranges + NAT assignment.
2) You provision a service account for 'edgecol-redwood-prod' and share the key via secure transfer (we prefer an S3 presigned URL with 24h expiry or HashiCorp Vault token).
3) For VPN, we need PSK or a cert bundle; if using mutual TLS, send the CA bundle and client cert name.
4) Firewall/port matrix: below is our minimal inbound/outbound matrix for the gateway:
   - Outbound: 443 to 0.0.0.0/0 (TLS) for model artifact pulls
   - Inbound: 22 (jumpbox) only from our office IPs (we can use a bastion/Jump host)
   - Management: 8400, 8500 for telemetry (TLS) to redwood telemetry endpoints

Attached: 'redwood-private-onboard-checklist.xlsx' version 1; it's a condensed checklist you can tick. I'll loop in Grace and Karthik for the connectivity validation.

If you prefer, we can run a 30-minute validation call at 2pm PT.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-private-onboard-checklist.xlsx

From: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 12:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Gateway handoff + credentials we promised

On Sun, Apr 18, 2027 at 10:03 AM Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Attached: 'redwood-private-onboard-checklist.xlsx' version 1; it's a condensed checklist you can tick. I'll loop in Grace and Karthik for the connectivity validation.

Thanks — quick notes from infra QA:
- Can we get the expected TLS SNI hostnames for outgoing telemetry? We need these to validate egress domain allowlist.
- For service account keys: we cannot accept raw key files via email. If EdgeCol cannot provide a Vault-backed approach, ask them to upload to our secure intake bucket and provide a presigned GET.
- For the bastion/jumpbox, we prefer ephemeral certs (SSH CA) over static keys. Is EdgeCol able to support short-lived certs?

I'll be on the 2pm PT slot if the customer confirms.

-grace

Grace O'Connor
Private Deploy Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Ryan Matthews <ryan.matthews@edgecol.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@edgecol.com
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 14:31:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Gateway handoff + credentials we promised

Aditya / Grace,

Thanks — we can do 2pm PT. Answers:
- Egress SNI: telemetry.redwood-inference.com and artifacts.redwood-inference.com
- We'll provision a service account and stage the key in our secure S3 with a presigned URL (24h). Link will be shared to the Redwood security mailbox and to Aditya.
- Bastion: we can issue short-lived certs via our internal CA (30m TTL) — we'll coordinate the CA signing endpoint in the call.

I'll send the presigned link 10 minutes before the meeting.

Ryan

Head of Infrastructure, EdgeCol Logistics

- Karthik will run a preflight smoke test during the 2pm call to validate egress + SNI resolution.
- Marissa will capture evidence (screenshot of successful curl to telemetry endpoint and recorded traceroute) for the audit packet.

See you at 2pm.
